datasets.title: WorldPop India unconstrained individual-countries population count 2011 (100 m)
datasets.description: Estimated PEOPLE PER GRID CELL (counts), NOT density. Never reproject/resample with averaging; aggregate by summation only.
datasets.source: WorldPop Global 2000-2020 (individual countries, unconstrained, 1 km/100 m release 2018-11)

provenance.upstream_license: CC BY 4.0 (WorldPop; cite Tatem 2017 / WorldPop hub DOI per country page)
provenance.upstream_edition: WorldPop Global 2000-2020 (individual countries, unconstrained, 1 km/100 m release 2018-11)
processing_steps: windowed crop (no resampling) to bbox (77.9, 16.9, 79.1, 17.9); counts, mask and NoData unchanged

datasets.title: GHSL GHS-BUILT-S R2023A total built-up SURFACE 2000 (100 m, Mollweide)
datasets.description: Built-up SURFACE area in square metres per 100 m cell (0..10000). Not GHS-BUILT-V volume. All built-up surface.

provenance.upstream_license: CC BY 4.0 (European Union, JRC; attribution required)
processing_steps: extract GHSL tile zip (tile checksums in upstream_checksums)
windowed crop of native Mollweide ESRI:54009 100 m tile to bbox (77.9, 16.9, 79.1, 17.9)
m2/cell -> area fraction (/10000) -> area-weighted average warp (Resampling.average) onto the WorldPop EPSG:4326 3 arc-sec grid -> x geodesic cell area; NoData kept as NoData
area-conservation diagnostic: relative_diff=-0.00561
